headline: Fishermans Row Split Again; Stonecradle and Farranac Shift
war_summary: Since the last edition, Stonecradle no longer carries a neutral gap: the Warden post count now stands at three and the Colonial count at six, with Buckler Sound as the busiest name on the regional sheet. Farranac Coast has shifted too, falling from two Warden posts to one, while another former post now lies neutral among nine Colonial-held positions; Transient Valley and The Bone Haft remain points of action. Fishermans Row, wholly Colonial in the previous dispatch, is again divided, one Warden post now standing against eight Colonial, with fresh fight near Fort Ember and Dankana Post. Linn Mercy still holds eleven Colonial posts; the earlier Rotdust and Lathair exchanges have gone quiet on the ownership wire. Gutter remains entirely Warden. Weathered Expanse is unchanged at six Warden posts to three Colonial and still active around Crow's Nest and Frostmarch; Stlican Shelf likewise holds at five to four after Thornhold action. The casualty ledgers are heaviest in Stonecradle and Weathered Expanse. No faction has yet reached the required thirty-four victory towns.
